hypothesis: Less title emphasis or anchoring semantic scores to original concat cosines reduces paraphrase intent drift without losing other-segment gains.
interpretation: Post-investigation exploratory experiment, no multiple-testing correction. Freeze plan before scoring; do not extend grid after outcomes.
recovery_rules: Paraphrase nDCG and source MRR at least approved baseline.
Other segment nDCG at least both baseline and field25 challenger; other segment source MRR at least baseline.
Existing baseline promotion screen must pass for promotion eligibility.
scope: 100 dev queries, frozen labels/candidate100/score caches. Held-out untouched.
scoring: semantic = a*concat + (1-a)*(t*title+(1-t)*abstract); then 25% candidate100-max BM25 +75% candidate100-max semantic. Stable baseline ties; reorder baseline top10 only, preserve positions11+. No query routing.
setting_description: Six fixed settings: concat control, abstract-only,10% title, 25% title control, and25% title anchored50/75% to concat.
